description_zh: 调用DeleteMonitorGroup接口删除指定的应用分组
name: DeleteMonitorGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. A dry run includes checks such as permissions and instance status validation. Valid values:

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the name and description of the route table are modified.
true: Sends a dry run request. Only the check is performed, and the name and description of the route table are not modified. Check items include whether required parameters are specified and the request format. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改路由表的名称和描述信息。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会路由表的名称和描述信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, and you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
